paragraphs: In Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8, R' Tanchuma, R' Meyasha and R' Yirmeyah reported in R' Shmuel bar Kahana’s name.[^1]

notes.text: פ״ד-ח is read as chapter 4 section 8, without independently checked modern correspondence. The source prints and before both Meyasha and Yirmeyah; neither conjunction is a missing translator supplement. All three reporters remain grouped in Shmuel’s name. All five personal title occurrences remain R'.
